Bachelor's degree in related area and / or equivalent experience and / or training.
Experience serving and supporting graduate students.

Under the direction of the Director of Graduate Student Affairs, the Graduate Advisor serves as the primary specialist for Professional MS graduate degree programs at the Silicon Valley Campus. The incumbent is responsible and accountable for the overall development, oversight, and coordination of all programmatic activities and support services for graduate programs. While graduate advisors divide primary workloads along departmental lines, they collaborate closely to reflect the interdisciplinary nature of BE academic programs - frequently cross-advising students and providing coverage or backup for one another as needed.

With this wide scope of responsibility, the Graduate Advisor applies knowledge of policies and procedures pertinent to graduate education at UCSC generally and BE specifically to problem-solve while interacting directly with faculty and graduate students in BE programs. Ensuring consolidated and cooperative services for all graduate students, the incumbent is often required to move seamlessly between unique programs with separate requirements and distinct tracks of study.
Selected candidate will be required to pass a pre-employment criminal history background check.
Selected candidate must pass the employment misconduct disclosure process.

The selected candidate will be required to work primarily on campus, with periods of remote work possible based on operational needs. If a hybrid work schedule is confirmed, the selected candidate must be able to work successfully from a home/remote office and be able to fulfill the requirements of the UCSC telecommuting agreement.
Selected candidate will be required to complete training within established time frames as directed including UC compliance training.
